roman_numeral.description: Convert an Arabic integer (1-39) to Roman numerals, few-shot. Control: same format but the second line is the arabic successor.

number_word.description: Write a small integer (0-20) as an English number word, few-shot. Control: same format but answer is the digits repeated.

month_successor.description: Name the month k (1-3) months after a given month. Control: same format with integer + k.

weekday_successor.description: Name the weekday k (1-3) days after a given weekday. Control: same format with letters of the alphabet.

object_color.description: Name the typical colour of a familiar object (banana->yellow, grass->green). Control: same sentences asking for the object's category (fruit, plant...).

nationality_to_country.description: Map a nationality adjective to its country (German -> Germany). Control: same format but copy the adjective.

ordinal_word.description: Write the English ordinal word for an integer 1-10 (3 -> third). Control: same format but answer is the cardinal word (3 -> three).

comparative_adjective.description: Form the comparative of an adjective (big -> bigger, good -> better). Control: same format but repeat the base adjective.

reasons: a random same-size part dropped the target as much (0.2817)
